Service network

We provide installation, repair, deep cleaning, and preventive maintenance from Vijayawada, with service coverage in Krishna, Guntur, Prakasam, West Godavari, East Godavari, and Visakhapatnam districts. These are service areas, not necessarily branch offices. Please contact us to confirm availability for your exact location and equipment.

SERVICE PROCESS

A clear process, from enquiry to service.

Tell us what equipment needs attention and where it is located. We’ll review the details, confirm the next steps and coordinate the service.

01

Share the requirement

Send the appliance or kitchen equipment details, location and a brief description on WhatsApp or through the enquiry form.

02

Confirm the next step

Our team will contact you to clarify the issue and discuss service scope, availability and applicable charges.

03

Coordinate the service

Once the details are confirmed, we’ll coordinate the visit or follow-up and keep communication clear.
